summary: Nez Perce NF lookout site on Blacktail Butte: L-4 cab on a tower in the 1930s, abandoned around 1948, listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned around 1948 and listed as gone; no source we read describes what, if anything, remains.

events.note: Abandoned around 1948: firelookout.com 'Abandoned 1948'; Idaho Fire Lookouts '1948 – Abandoned'; Forest Lookouts 'c.1948'; Forest Service list 'abandoned 1948 +/-'. No built event, because the 1930s build date has no exact year in any source.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Frisco Peak pages say a 1926 log cabin stood atop Blacktail Butte. The Forest Service list puts that cabin in its Blacktail (Frisco Peak) row, at T33N, R11E Sect. 9. Blacktail Butte's own pages mention no cabin, so the story does not attribute one to this lookout.

notes_for_editor: Decade-only dating: the sources say 1930s (Forest Lookouts with a question mark), so there is no built event. No source names a staff member, and Idaho Fire Lookouts says none is documented. Forest Lookouts and the Forest Service list both draw on Ray Kresek's Fire Lookouts of the Northwest, so they are not independent confirmation of each other. Name clash: Blacktail (Frisco Peak) is a separate record (FFLOS US 1172, ID 11, 46.20829 -115.10781). Its pages say a 1926 cabin stood atop Blacktail Butte; the Forest Service list gives that cabin to Frisco. Unresolved, and the story keeps the cabin out of this history. The brief coordinates (45.89062, -115.99708) fit the Forest Service location (T30N R4E Sect. 31, 6 miles ESE of Grangeville). Brief record checked (county Idaho, kind tower, gone): no correction. Not read: the Kresek book, Nez Perce NF district files, any photograph. Today: no source describes the site.
